nom: Sweet July Skin Pava Exfoliating Cleanser

avis.texte: I've been using Sweet July cleanser for a while now and I love it. I have normal (to dry) skin and find it soothing and invigorating. Love the fact that they use natural ingredients that includes a great exfoliator, perfect for my skin type. Also, it never leaves my skin feeling "over cleansed". I highly recommend this product!!

I've been using Sweet July Skin's Pava Cleanser and love it. It has a minty coolness when I wash off and smells like a dream - not to mention leaves my skin feeling fresh and not dry like other cleansers I have used in the past.

When I tried this product I was amazed at first by the pleasant smell, Loved It! I then enjoyed the gentle exfoliation, I could feel it but it wasn't harsh. Very Pleased with this product. A little pricey but worth it.

I saw these products featured on CBS morning show and love them. The exfoliating gel works well but is still gentle.
I love this cleanser! The cooling sensation is my favorite part. I have an immediately clean feel to my skin, this cleanser has been added this to my daily products and I will be ordering more!
Absolutely love this product, its minty fresh on my skin…glad I found!
Love love these products at 60 my skin looks like I am in my 40's ever since I started using them. Only thing I need is a sunscreen.

The Sweet July skin products are just perfect for my 71 year old skin type. 😀 I'm enjoying the full effects of each product used to create the cleanser, serums, oils, and eye cream. My skin glows all day!!

Loving the Pava exfoliating wash. I have sensitive skin and almost everything makes me red. This wash did not at all!!! I've been using it for a couple weeks now and already notice clearer and glowing skin! It will be my new go to!

This along with several Sweet july products have become my got for face care.
This is my second order! Gentle yet effective cleanser. Leaves skin feeling cleanser but not dry. Lovely.

avis.titre: I love, love the entire l
avis.texte: I love, love the entire line of Sweet July exfoliate Cleanser. A little goes a long ways. I just add a dime size to my finger and it glides so smooth on my face. If feels like a mint feeling and I can feel it cleansing my pores. I follow up next with the toner which feels magnificent and it smells wonderful. Then, I apply the serum which feels so smooth. Lastly, I apply the Castaway cream which just tops off your face and it looks so hydrated & radiant. You're skin feels so soft an luxurious! Thanks Ayesha for creating wonderful skin care products that work and are not harmful to your skin. I am 53 yrs old and will be using these products for the rest of my life. Until next time....A Happy Customer!😊
Luv, luv this Cleanser. I've been using this with the other skincare and it just leaves my skin feeling so radiant. I've been using this for over 2 months and I am a customer for life.
Love the texture because product is smooth rather than abrasive.

avis.titre: It is easy going on with
avis.texte: It is easy going on with a slight fragrance and cleans well. It is not harsh! Thanks for taking this on to help women and men. I love the toner, vitamin c and moisturizer as well.

I will never buy another face wash. This is the perfect daily gentle-scrub that is not drying and leaves my skin plump and glowing. The best part is the mint ingredient that opens up my sinuses and is so very therapeutic - it wakes me up and makes me feel so fresh and so clean!

avis.titre: I love All the products e
avis.texte: I love All the products except the mint in this cleanser; it is so strong that the vapors from it sting my eyes and it's too cooling on my face which feels uncomfortable.

avis.titre: First let me say I was ve
avis.texte: First let me say I was very happy with how quickly my purchase arrived. Really liked the inside packaging especially the knitted bag it came in. Can utilize it for something else. But the magic happened when I used this product for the first time. I'm an older woman and in my lifetime I have used, purchased, thrown out a lot of skincare products. So I think I kinda know what result I'm looking for. For starters you don't need a huge amount of this facial wash. A little really goes a long way, isnt sticky and glides over the skin. It rinses easily and OMG your skin feels so soft and has a really clean look about it. And again no sticky residue like some cleansers give and the exfoliating properties rinse completely off the skin. I totally loved the way my skin felt afterwards and even when it was dry. I will give this a 👍🏽 and a 20 out of 10. I can't wait to see/feel the other products in the line. I just ordered the toner and can only imagine the two of them together. 💜

avis.titre: I haven't been able to fi
avis.texte: I haven't been able to find a product that hydrates my skin until now. I LOVE all the products from Sweet July!

I've been waiting my whole life for a face scrub like this!! It is perfect for my skin type and I use it every day. It does not dry out my skin and leaves it clean and healthy. I have sensitive skin and I don't have any problems. been added, plus is the fabulous packaging, minimalist design and looks great in my bathroom!

I love my Pava Exfoliating Cleanser! It feels like going on a beach getaway everytime I use it! Other cleansers have felt abrasive on my skin and sometimes dry it out, but this cleanser feels smooth and makes me feel fresh afterwards. I love using the Toner after too. I am looking forward to trying more Sweet July Skin products!
Unique scent, great cleaning and gentle resurfacing. I followed with the Pava Toner and my face is super clean, healthy, and very happy.
This is my second purchase of the Pava Exfoliating Cleanser. I'm hooked. Great stuff!

I have never received compliments on my skin until I started using this cleanser. My skin is so soft and clear! But I have to say, the SMELL brings me to my happy place somewhere tropical - this product brings me joy every time I use it!

avis.titre: I love this product! I ha
avis.texte: I love this product! I have very dry, sensitive skin and it's one of the only cleansers I can use that doesn't make my skin feel like it could crack because it's so dry after using it. I don't even need moisturizer after I use it most of the time!
The toner Cleans and evens the tone of my skin. The skin Feels amazing after use.

This cleanser is wonderful ! You get the tingling feeling when using. I've used it for maybe two weeks now and have physically seen the improvement of the dark splotches on my cheek area. Definitely will be purchasing again once my current one is out!
A well-balanced, refreshing cleanser that's perfect for my sensitive skin. It provides just the right amount of exfoliation.

My hand accidentally brushed my face the other day and I couldn't believe how soft and smooth it was. I'm a chronically dehydrated, workaholic nearing 40 but my face now feels hydrated and smooth, like in my 20s. One might describe my skincare routine as basic, hurried, and lacking the appropriate seriousness with which to slow my skins downward march to middle age. This is why it's been a game changer for me. I find every step to be delightful, starting with the cleanser which has a gentle exfoliant and leaves you feeling tingling clean.

avis.texte: After the first use I felt a brightness to my skin and refreshed.

avis.texte: At for me! Love the gentle exfoliation. Leaves me feeling clean but moisturized. Smells amazing!
Really like the tingle in this cleanser, perfect for the morning.
Amazing! I love how clean and smooth my skin feels after this step.
I really enjoyed this product. A light exfoliation but after a few uses, my skin's texture felt a lot smoother!

The cleanser has a creamy texture thats light weight and goes on the skin super smooth. Left my skin feeling clean but not stripped of moisture. Feel super confident using as my daily cleaners even though it's an exfoliant.
Love this cleanser! It leaves my skin moisturized and refreshed.

The exfoliant is like nothing else - you truly feel like you're at a luxury spa on a tropical vacation. The scent is DEVINE and the lychee seeds are a nice touch that feel so natural and effective. Your skin feels soft as soon you put it on and you can feel it work.

avis.titre: I love this! But I wouldn
avis.texte: I love this! But I wouldn't use it 2x a day, but it is gently enough for daily use and removes all of my makeup without any remover needed before. I love the cooling sensation and it leaves my skin feeling so soft.

I love the Pava Exfoliating Cleanser. It is light, smooth, and and gentle on my skin (I have very sensitive and dry skin). I've been using the cleanser for two weeks and already my skin is brighter and more smooth. I deal with hyperpigmentation so the added glycolic acid is a bonus for me. Also love the smell and how fresh my face feels after using.

avis.titre: Instantly a part of my sk
avis.texte: Instantly a part of my skincare routine! It's so refreshing to finally find a face cleanser that smells good, actually works and does not dry out my skin. The exfoliating lychee seeds feel great, but my favorite part about this cleanser is the subtle and cooling mint sensation it leaves on my face.

LOVE the smell and fresh feel after using it. The exfoliant isn't too much so it feels nice to use everyday and not too much. Absolutely love the packaging. Would definitely recommend to others and continue to use.

I don't typically exfoliate on a daily basis but this cleanser was incredibly hydrating, never made my skin feel stripped. The smell is amazing and after rinsing, left my skin feeling cool. A great addition to my morning routine

The cleanser is my favorite! Pillowy soft, light, refreshing, and super exfoliating all at the same time! I look forward to using this cleanser, especially on mornings when I feel like I need some extra exfoliation.
The "minty" smell at times can be a bit too overpowering. Although, I don't think there's any mints listed in the ingredient list.

Love the pava exfoliating cleanser! I immediately noticed the sweet guava/papaya/lychee scent, and I was left with a minty fresh, clean feeling :). It's also super hydrating and works great for my sensitive, dry/combination skin.
The lychee seed powder in the cleanser is a game changer that truly made my skin feel refreshed. It's also a perfect blend of fruits that left a refreshing scent on my face.

avis.titre: I love the beads and the
avis.texte: I love the beads and the scent of this product. It's a much gentler exfoliator than most which I appreciate it, especially for daily use.

Overall I really like this cleanser. I loved the fresh tingling feeling after use. I appreciated the it didn't fry out my skin. I tend to have sensitive and dry skin so i was nervous at first but loved the results, i'm about 2 week into using and cant wait to see what my 30 day results will look like.

avis.titre: I liked the smell of the
avis.texte: I liked the smell of the cleanser as well as the consistency. I like the creamy texture and that there was enough grit to the exfoliator that felt like it was getting the job done gently but effectively and without scrubbing your face off. I love the minty post-wash feel and I also liked the neutral, simple packaging. It lends a very zen and spa-like quality to the products that I think is matched in their ingredients, textures and scents.
